name: Hoshea
summary: A son of Elah who killed King Pekah and reigned nine years over Israel in Samaria. In his days Assyria's king captured Samaria and took Israel into exile.

key_moments.title: Plotting Against Pekah
key_moments.description: Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah king of Israel. He struck Pekah down and became king instead.

key_moments.title: Caught Between Two Kings
key_moments.description: Hoshea served Shalmaneser, Assyria's king, and paid him tribute, then turned to So king of Egypt and stopped paying. When Assyria's king learned of this, he had Hoshea bound in prison.

key_moments.title: Samaria Falls
key_moments.description: The king of Assyria besieged Samaria for three years. In Hoshea's ninth year he took the city and sent the people of Israel off to Assyria.
